steps: Sign in to Airtable; this is the Builder hub → Personal access tokens
Name it, add scopes (e.g. data.records:read, data.records:write) and choose the bases it may access
Click 'Create token' and copy it (treat it as an opaque secret) - it is shown exactly once

least_privilege.summary: Give the token only the scopes it needs (e.g. data.records:read) and only the bases it must touch.
